title: Restaurant Financial Forecast Template for Excel, 3 Year Restaurant Business Plan Projections
desc:
PLAINSUM BY KOVA · BUSINESS FORECASTS IN PLAIN ENGLISH

Test your restaurant plan before you sign a lease.

The Plainsum Restaurant Forecast turns plain answers about your restaurant into three years of sales, costs, profit and cash, month by month. It's made for first-time restaurant owners. No finance background needed.

━━ HOW IT WORKS ━━
1. Answer the questions in Your numbers. Nine short steps, from what you already know (rent, fit-out, your team) to what you have to estimate (how often each seat is used and what guests spend). Every question has a short note, and a rough guide for restaurants where one exists.
2. Read the Dashboard. Your year at a glance: sales, profit, cash over three years, money in and out each month, where your money goes, and six key ratios. Pick Year 1, 2 or 3 at the top.
3. Share the Bank pack. What you're asking for and how much is yours, whether the restaurant can repay a loan, the cash month by month, and three years of profit and loss, cash flow and balance sheet.

━━ WHAT YOU GET ━━
• Restaurant Forecast, EXAMPLE: filled in for a made-up 60-seat restaurant, so you can see how a finished forecast works
• Restaurant Forecast, BLANK: the same workbook, ready for your restaurant
• An 8-page PDF setup guide: what to have on hand, the nine steps, reading the Dashboard, seats and prime cost, sharing with a lender, and common questions

━━ WHAT IT SHOWS YOU ━━
• Your lowest cash month over three years, compared with the minimum cash you choose
• How many guests a day you need to break even, next to the number you've planned
• Loan payments covered for each year, if you borrow
• Six key ratios, including food and drink costs, staff costs and prime cost, each with what to aim for and an On track, Check or Fix label
• Low, Base and High versions: switch one box to see a slower or busier start
• Profit and loss, cash flow and balance sheet for three years

━━ BUILT FOR RESTAURANTS ━━
Guests come from your seats and how often each seat is used at lunch and at dinner. Takeaway and delivery sit on top, with app commission charged only on orders that come through apps. Your menu mix has its own cost for food, soft drinks, beer and wine, and spirits. Front-of-house and kitchen staff are planned by the hour, and part of those hours rise and fall with how busy you are. Private dining and catering can be invoiced and paid later. Fit-out months come before opening, with rent-free months if your landlord gives them. Sales tax, tips and gift cards are kept out of your sales, because they aren't your money.

━━ GOOD TO KNOW ━━
• Made for Microsoft Excel on Windows or Mac (Excel 2016 or later, or Microsoft 365). No macros.
• The Dashboard needs the Excel desktop app to show its cards and charts. They don't show in Google Sheets, Excel on the web or Apple Numbers.
• Any currency, any country. You enter your own tax rates.
• Funding with your own money only? Enter no loan and the forecast adjusts.
• Instant download. This is a digital product: nothing will be shipped.

Please note: this is a planning tool that estimates what may happen from the answers you give. It isn't a guarantee or financial, tax, legal or lending advice. The example restaurant and its numbers are made up for illustration. License: for one business. Please don't share or resell the files.

Start with the EXAMPLE file and change a few answers to see how the Dashboard moves. Then open the BLANK file for your own restaurant, with the guide beside it.

AI tools helped during the build.
